source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-sanctions-screen-official-lists-aws
protocol: generic
name: Sanctions screen over official OFAC, UN and EU lists
description: >-
  Free, public, no-key screening API. Screens a person, company, vessel or crypto wallet address against
  the official OFAC SDN and Consolidated (non-SDN) lists, the UN Security Council consolidated list and the
  EU consolidated financial sanctions list, including near-matches on spelling and transliteration.
  Returns matched (true/false), the matching entries, the lists checked with their publication dates, and
  the best match score. Operated by the contributor; built only from the official list files.
base_url: https://ngrgakvwtxioa2kkdllvhn5pza0fxqcb.lambda-url.eu-north-1.on.aws
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
  - path: /screen
    external_path: /screen
    method: GET
    description: >-
      Screen one name or wallet address against OFAC SDN, OFAC non-SDN, UN and EU sanctions lists.
      USE THIS for SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL. Send only the name or address, not the whole question.
    intents:
      - SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL
    params:
      query:
        required:
          - name: name
            type: string
            intents:
              - '*'
            description: The person, company or vessel name, or the wallet address, to screen (1-256 characters).
intent_mapping:
  SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /screen
    input:
      name: { from: name, how: "Only the name or wallet address; drop dates of birth, countries, IMO numbers and titles." }
    output:
      name: { path: name }
      matched: { path: matched, how: "JSON boolean: true when any list entry matched at or above the threshold." }
      matches: { path: "matches[].name" }
      lists: { path: "lists[].list" }
      match_score: { path: match_score }
semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL
